verdict.rationale: Docs show API endpoints to list/get/delete ingested documents and a full self-hosting option (own binary, data never leaves your infrastructure), which together enable a form of data portability and reduce lock-in, but there is no documented bulk 'export all my data' feature or explicit open-format (JSON/CSV) export guarantee. missing for 10: dedicated bulk export endpoint/tool, explicit open data-format specification, independent confirmation of successful full export.
